SELECT pp.*, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username, pp.operator) AS operator FROM pro_work_process pp LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = pp.operator_user_id
INNER JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = pp.work_order_id
AND wo.assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}
ORDER BY pp.create_time DESC

SELECT pp.*, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username, pp.operator) AS operator FROM pro_work_process pp LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = pp.operator_user_id WHERE pp.process_record_id = #{processRecordId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pro_work_process pp INNER JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = pp.work_order_id SET pp.report_qty = pp.report_qty + #{reportQty}, pp.version = pp.version + 1 WHERE pp.process_record_id = #{processRecordId} AND pp.status = '1' AND pp.version = #{version} AND (pp.report_qty + #{reportQty}) <= wo.plan_qty
